scope: change_apply interrupted at each durable journal boundary (checkpointing; applying before mutation_applied; mutation_applied before changed_project_saved; changed_project_saved before applied) by terminating the worker and its owned TIA, and by Host transport loss while applying, for one representative per reconciliation route: source_upsert (project fingerprint), hardware_plug (project + configured hardware), to_create (target-dependent). Each case reconciles once in a fresh owned TIA, asserts the exact disposition, exactly one apply admission (no replay), checkpoint recovery by project_retrieve when released or ResourceBusy while held, and an independent fresh read of the original project for the effect.
limitations: Interruption is process termination of the worker with its owned TIA, or of the Host; power loss, disk faults and remote transport are not exercised.
One representative kind per reconciliation route: the run qualifies each route's reconciliation, not every kind's native mutation.
The save-time rule trusts the checkpoint archive's file write time; the archive hash is verified, its timestamp is not.
Library transactions are covered by the separate library interruption records, not by this run.
